text: Words fail me to describe that ice cream. Marilla, I assure you it was sublime.” That evening Marilla told the whole story to Matthew over her stocking basket. “I’m willing to own up that I made a mistake,” she concluded candidly, “but I’ve learned a lesson. I have to laugh when I think of Anne’s ‘confession,’ although I suppose I shouldn’t for it really was a falsehood. But it doesn’t seem as bad as the other would have been, somehow, and anyhow I’m responsible for it.
